ee78845a42e64b2e00ba8a844e65@global-arts.description: In her practice, Dayanita Singh experiments with form through photography, architecture, and books to create exhibitions. Using these mediums, Singh extends an invitation to audiences to question how books, and book-making, might transform a space into an exhibition. This show takes cues from Singh’s artist-led approach to exhibitions to explore the relationship between “making” and “reading.” With Singh’s Book Building (2022) as a blueprint, this exhibition analyzes book-making as an artistic practice, material form, and conceptual process. Works in the exhibition span Singh’s career, including Book Building (2022), Blue Book (2009), File Room (2013), Museum of Chance (2014), and Sent a Let

3fd0d89b7fc1a501df467378a192@global-arts.description: About the Exhibit When Fidel Castro opened the Mariel Harbor to let Cubans sail for America, Edel Rodriguez and his family took their chance. From the town of El Gabriel to the Mariel port to a rickety shrimping boat bound for Florida, they joined the 1980 boatlift, becoming “worms,” as Castro called the departing Cubans. Years later, Edel Rodriguez has become one of the most prominent political artists of our age, hailed for his iconic work on the cover of Time, Der Spiegel and on jumbotrons around the world. 2ef4b66756ba0314e30f2dffc33b@global-arts.description: Elizabeth Field and David Sariti: 2 Violinists, 4 Violins, 8 Bows and 400 Years of Music! This wide-ranging program gives audiences a rare opportunity to hear first-hand the evolution of the violin and its bows. Field and Sariti will guide the listener through time by explaining the evolution in construction and how it mirrored changes in compositional and playing style. From early 17th-century consort music, to the high Baroque, domestic Classical music, Romantic chamber music, and concert pieces of the 20th and 21st centuries, the listener will experience the equivalent of four concerts in one!

This talk, drawing on a forthcoming Stanford University Press book that blends scholarly research with insider political experience, proposes a relational materialist framework. 5e8695959ff31c30de5862d4db33@global-arts.description: The Bancroft Library’s collections of materials relating to the Philippines span nearly 500 years. Highlights in this exhibit include a transcript of an Inquisitorial trial from 1646, a prayer book written in the Cebuano language, and UC Berkeley Filipino student publications from 1905 to the present. 028a75c53543c1a9b35988df9516@global-arts.title: Film Screening: Raging Bull
028a75c53543c1a9b35988df9516@global-arts.description: Martin Scorsese and Robert De Niro make the biography of boxer Jake LaMotta into a visceral meditation on existential suffering. Eschewing the romance associated with the sport, Raging Bull shows the struggle of an athlete whose willful determination to succeed on his own terms takes its toll on all those around him—friends and adversaries in equal measure—before he is undermined by self-loathing. Every punch is framed, lit, and cut for maximum impact, with black-and-white cinematography inspired by James Wong Howe. “A fusion of Hollywood genre with personal vision … closer to poetry than pulp. Its sculptural weight can only be appreciated on the big screen” (Amy Taubin, Village Voice ).

cfdacd82a223a4829ef87f2bf589@global-arts.description: A story from The Current, featuring legendary design editor Robert Rufino, Street Theater offers a look at his early work creating some of New York’s most memorable window displays. Lift is capital's tendency to pull away from fixed costs, from the ground, from the sphere of human affairs. You can see it in an airline that no longer sells seats but positions in a queue, or in a telecom operator that sells its towers and keeps using them as a tenant. b6f2b1623e0e957cbcb2685d9d14@global-arts.description: Programa: Where Did Our Love Go? (1966, 15') Días en la Factory de Warhol... Visitas fortuitas, destellos de Janis, Castelli y Bellevue... Malanga trabajando... visionados de El desprecio y Con la muerte en los talones ... grupos femeninos de rock y la inauguración de una discoteca... un recorrido por el MoMA... A Woman's Touch (1983, 21') Tomando como modelo Marnie, la ladrona (Alfred Hitchcock, 1964), donde el personaje de Tippi Hedren queda absorbido por la presencia dominante de Sean Connery, Sonbert recrea esa tensión entre la dominación masculina y la (in)dependencia femenina: los hombres aparecen principalmente en posiciones de poder y negocios, mientras que las mujeres son mostradas

59079ccf4fa387a4495229bc4d04@global-arts.title: Warren Sonbert. Sesión de cortometrajes II
59079ccf4fa387a4495229bc4d04@global-arts.description: Programa: The Cup and the Lip (1986, 20') Una película compleja y desafiante que inspiraría a cineastas audaces durante años. Aunque sus imágenes son demasiado densas, variadas y vertiginosas para ser analizadas por completo tras un solo visionado, la película parece un ensayo melancólico y quizás sarcástico sobre la fragilidad humana y el esfuerzo por evitar el caos mediante instituciones políticas y religiosas, que conllevan sus propios peligros de control social y manipulación mental. Amphetamine (1966, 10') En su primera película, Sonbert representa a hombres jóvenes que se inyectan anfetamina y hacen el amor en plena era de sexo, drogas y rock and roll. 7479e453d41c4914d6c9a442b6a4@global-arts.title: La sexta parte del mundo
7479e453d41c4914d6c9a442b6a4@global-arts.description: Encargada por la empresa estatal de comercio, Shestaya chast mira convierte la celebración propagandística de la Unión Soviética en una sinfonía de culturas, paisajes y rostros, «desde el faro más allá del Círculo Ártico hasta las montañas del Cáucaso», así como en un experimento en el uso poético de los intertítulos. Warren Sonbert reconoció en el montaje de Vertov un modelo para su propio cine: menos orientado a imponer un significado preestablecido que a abrir un espacio de emociones y correspondencias ambiguas entre imágenes. > Presentación a cargo de Francisco Algarín y Carlos Saldaña, comisarios del ciclo.

4f7bb5d32836fb24d875b50b2e01@global-arts.title: Marnie, la ladrona
4f7bb5d32836fb24d875b50b2e01@global-arts.description: Marnie pone en escena un intercambio de culpa y deseo entre personajes profundamente ambiguos, a la vez que fuerza al público a una incómoda toma de posición moral. Entre el melodrama y la pesadilla, Hitchcock tensa valores plásticos como el color y el encuadre en un mundo continuamente desestabilizado. Su vivaz y cruel circulación de los puntos de vista tiene un eco en el cine de Sonbert, donde su montaje sustituye la narración por una red abierta de correspondencias. > Presentación a cargo de Francisco Algarín y Carlos Saldaña, comisarios del ciclo.

0b5c3ef525ddacf79a4165ad3f43@global-arts.title: Escrito sobre el viento
0b5c3ef525ddacf79a4165ad3f43@global-arts.description: Warren Sonbert veía en Douglas Sirk a un cineasta capaz de revelar las fisuras del mundo burgués sin que sus personajes quedaran nunca reducidos a héroes o villanos. Written on the Wind relata la desestructuración más absoluta de una familia inmensamente rica, desplegada en un exuberante mundo plástico. La narración, a golpe de giros, acompaña a unos personajes atrapados en sucesivos círculos de deseo, frustración y repetición. La saturación expresiva, de una espectacularidad casi operística, y los hallazgos del montaje recuerdan a la sensibilidad del propio cine de Sonbert. > Presentación a cargo de Francisco Algarín y Carlos Saldaña, comisarios del ciclo.

95c09ccbeaae60335a6d0b3422e4@global-arts.description: Andalusia, 1937. 07b66041719e504f69aaeb7ec105@global-arts.title: VHS Deathmatch: Dead on Arrival
07b66041719e504f69aaeb7ec105@global-arts.venue: Wild Heaven West End Brewery & Gardens
07b66041719e504f69aaeb7ec105@global-arts.description: Atlanta’s trash-cinema showdown returns from the dead. VHS Deathmatch pits two cult horror movies against each other in a live, interactive battle: RETURN OF THE LIVING DEAD (1985) vs. NIGHT OF THE CREEPS (1986). We’re not showing the full movies. We’ve chopped them down to their wildest scenes — creatures, practical effects, ridiculous dialogue, exploding heads and everything else worth arguing about. Between rounds, our hosts and guests break down the madness, roast what deserves roasting and make their case. Then the audience votes to decide the winner. One movie survives. The other meets its maker. Friday, October 16 at Wild Heaven Beer – West End. Free admission with RSVP.

413890a2a0395832578f4d103d7e@global-arts.description: What is Design Next? Presented by the Museum of Design Atlanta in partnership with the Peachtree Branch of the Fulton County Library System, Design Next is a free architecture program for students in grades 9-12. In this session, we’ll explore how architects use drawing to observe, communicate, and develop ideas. Students will practice observational sketching techniques used by designers while learning how line weight, contour drawing, and perspective help communicate three-dimensional spaces on paper. 622b9de456bfc956de50f13690a0@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
622b9de456bfc956de50f13690a0@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

Sample’s unparalleled artistry seamlessly blended genres, taking the Crusaders from hard bop to a unique funk style infused with R&B. As a trailblazer in the jazz-funk movement, he shaped the evolution of The Crusaders into a pioneering fusion group. On his own, his performances on the acoustic piano were renowned for their lyrical phrasing and crystalline sound. Artist Amanda Banks has spent time tracing her own family’s connection to that history. The burlap sacks she latch-hooks aren’t just reclaimed materials. They’re a way of working through what she’s learned, stitch by stitch. In this hands-on workshop, Banks will teach participants basic latch-hook techniques using reclaimed coffee sacks and recycled yarn. 6071961e736891aa78ab6e71821d@global-arts.title: English Masters of the Theater and Court—Lauda Musicam Baroque Orchestra
6071961e736891aa78ab6e71821d@global-arts.description: By the end of the 17th century, a growing middle class created a demand for musical and theatrical productions, while the availability of sheet music and instruments in shops resulted in a more musically-literate society. Lauda Baroque will perform selections by Henry Purcell, John Blow, and George Frideric Handel—three of the central figures in 17th and 18th century England—while also paying homage to other composers who helped bring music to the masses. Suggested donation of $20; no one turned away.

4de1269babcd2c497789c81cd934@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
4de1269babcd2c497789c81cd934@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

02c12ef2d98d03582168d8895e30@global-arts.description: “The doors are open. The patients are waiting. Welcome to visiting hours at Spring Street Asylum. Fluorescent lights buzzing, linoleum peeling, and something rotten behind every closed door. Watch the institution unravel in real time: orderlies who know more than they’re letting on, patients who insist they’re the sane ones, and a staff smiling just a little too hard to be trusted. Every session, every secret, every scream is built live, in the room, right in front of you. From the creators of Night of the Living Improv and The Improv Cult Show: Seek the Truth comes Whole World’s next immersive nightmare. Admission is voluntary. Discharge is not guaranteed. This show is intended for a mature

3a4fd90693161dfb64076dd18a6b@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
3a4fd90693161dfb64076dd18a6b@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

ae83408c31d5dd01f37221b39e65@global-arts.description: Dr. Beverly J. Armento, an Atlanta author and educator, will moderate what is sure to be a lively discussion about Susan’s #1 New Release debut memoir, The Earth Is Flat?! And Other Things My Mother Taught Me. Reserve your ticket now! This laugh-out-loud and vulnerable debut MOMoir is about a homeschooled Pentecostal girl in the ’90s, her flat-earther mother, and the hilarious, heartbreaking work of figuring out what’s actually true. “Unputdownable” -The Santa Barbara Independent Susan has appeared on Jane the Virgin, The Mindy Project, and hosts L.A. This Week. She earned her B.A. in Journalism and Dramatic Art from UNC-Chapel Hill and a Master of Sustainable Tourism from ASU.

b49f502d15ef6d5cb60c104f7fc4@global-arts.description: What does it mean to grow older in a queer body, surrounded by queer community? Join MODA’s Queer Figure Drawing Night with Ashanti Hampton for Queer Across Generations, a special session celebrating queer bodies across time. For this gathering, we’ll welcome a queer elder as our model and make space to consider the beauty, complexity, and possibility of aging. So many of us carry questions about what it means to grow older: Will I be allowed to age? What does it look like to grow older in my body and in my community? 789d87b82b79a2ec0d20a56e5911@global-arts.title: Silent Night
789d87b82b79a2ec0d20a56e5911@global-arts.description: Silent Night is the powerful, true account of the spontaneous Christmas truce between French, British, and German soldiers during World War I. Based on the film “Joyeux Noël,” the story takes place on Christmas Eve, the opposing forces lay down their weapons, come together around a makeshift tree to sing carols, and play soccer matches. The soldiers’ peaceful actions are reprimanded by their commanders, but cast a lasting light on the goodness of humanity in the face of war. Artistic Director Tomer Zvulun will direct, and Principal Conductor Iván López Reynoso will conduct. 59891ef23041377735fce05486e7@global-arts.title: The Dynamic! – Funny scenes, songs and games!
59891ef23041377735fce05486e7@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

851fcb52e4d80ae03703f1e277ac@global-arts.description: Silent Night is the powerful, true account of the spontaneous Christmas truce between French, British, and German soldiers during World War I. Based on the film “Joyeux Noël,” the story takes place on Christmas Eve, the opposing forces lay down their weapons, come together around a makeshift tree to sing carols, and play soccer matches. The soldiers’ peaceful actions are reprimanded by their commanders, but cast a lasting light on the goodness of humanity in the face of war. Artistic Director Tomer Zvulun will direct, and Principal Conductor Iván López Reynoso will conduct. 10262fefff1cd00e96992b010802@global-arts.address: 100 Ivan Allen Jr. Boulevard NW, Atlanta, GA, 30313
10262fefff1cd00e96992b010802@global-arts.description: The fight for justice, equality, and civic participation belongs to all of us, and it is never too early to begin learning how to make a difference. CIVICS 4 ALL AGES! is a special family learning experience that helps participants better understand how government works, why civic engagement matters, and how individuals can create change in their communities. Through engaging discussions and real-world examples, families will explore the foundations of civics in a welcoming and accessible environment.

d6bd12ba9c4057e4a0d9b6b1986c@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. Every scene, game, and musical moment is built in real time, and the performers lean into the unexpected with a mix of confidence, silliness, and genuine surprise. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

f74cc377ddd37acae5cb4d5cb6f6@global-arts.title: Silent Night
f74cc377ddd37acae5cb4d5cb6f6@global-arts.description: Silent Night is the powerful, true account of the spontaneous Christmas truce between French, British, and German soldiers during World War I. Based on the film “Joyeux Noël,” the story takes place on Christmas Eve, the opposing forces lay down their weapons, come together around a makeshift tree to sing carols, and play soccer matches. The soldiers’ peaceful actions are reprimanded by their commanders, but cast a lasting light on the goodness of humanity in the face of war. Artistic Director Tomer Zvulun will direct, and Principal Conductor Iván López Reynoso will conduct. 298bedecf110087d6473f14df1f1@global-arts.description: The Dynamic! is an improv show that thrives on chaos, quick thinking, and whatever ideas the audience throws at the cast. They know how to turn a wild suggestion or a joke that goes off the rails into something even funnier, and half the joy is watching them navigate the mess together. The show moves fast, the energy stays high, and no two nights ever feel the same. You help spark the fun, and the cast runs with it to create a comedy experience that feels alive, loose, and completely in the moment.

97d80ff7d770d454d5b31df51419@global-arts.description: Tras el 11 de septiembre, un gato amarillo dibujado comienza a aparecer en los muros de París, observando la ciudad con una enigmática sonrisa. Chats perchés es una meditación poética sobre la memoria colectiva, la resistencia y la belleza inesperada en medio del caos. > Coloquio posterior con los arquitectos Aritz González y David García-Asenjo

c45a9ecd5cf31f52b6eab646ca5e@global-arts.title: Crossroads. El viaje circular de Boa Mistura
c45a9ecd5cf31f52b6eab646ca5e@global-arts.description: La periferia de Ciudad del Cabo, Sudáfrica, es el epicentro de un inspirador viaje a través del trabajo de Boa Mistura, colectivo artístico de proyección internacional con raíces en el graffiti y el arte urbano. En el camino, el arte urbano se convierte en el vehículo que conecta las vidas de un vecino de una favela en São Paulo, un joven del slum de Kibera, en Kenia, una indígena mapuche en el norte de Chile, un refugiado sirio y una mujer de una población pesquera de República Dominicana. Estos pequeños encuentros a través de la pintura son la semilla de cambios tanto en los vecinos de las comunidades como en el colectivo. > Encuentro posterior con los artistas de Boa Mistura.

b39c4ca57cd33cd917a14633382f@global-arts.description: The indispensable lexicon you need to face authoritarianism—from the country that’s been surviving it for centuries. America is not the first country to experience the stirring of tyranny; in Russia, it has been the law of the land for generations. Over the years, a vernacular of double-speak emerged, one that helped ordinary people make sense of how illiberalism takes shape and makes itself felt in daily life. It allowed them to talk about authoritarianism and to subvert it—with a healthy dose of humor and irony along the way. 7596524cf578634884fcddd37858@global-arts.description: The Bancroft Library’s collections of materials relating to the Philippines span nearly 500 years. Highlights in this exhibit include a transcript of an Inquisitorial trial from 1646, a prayer book written in the Cebuano language, and UC Berkeley Filipino student publications from 1905 to the present. The exhibit also features selections from the personal papers of acclaimed author Jessica Hagedorn, including typewritten drafts of her novels, poetry, song lyrics, and a screenplay, as well as childhood drawings and writings. Open hours may vary. Please view the The Bancroft Library hours page for the most up-to-date information.
